newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil firm to cut a gas field output December.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil firm to cut a gas field output December.

text.p: PTT Exploration and Production said output from the Bongkot gas field in the Gulf of Thailand, in which the firm has a 40 percent stake, would stop between 22-31 December due to maintenance requirements.

The stoppage will cut average daily output in December to 291 million cubic feet per day, down from a projected 350 million cubic feet. Normal production will resume early in 1997, PTTEP said in a statement.

The company said production would stop because Total Exploration and Production Co Ltd, a subsidiary of French oil giant Total and the operator of the Bongkot project, needed to do maintenance and replace equipment, the statement said. jam
